source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of recombinant DNA technology (PDF 155-156).

blocks.text: Recombinant DNA technology ka matlab hai mukhtalif zaraye ke DNA molecules ko kaat kar, jor kar aur mila kar aik hybrid molecule, recombinant DNA (rDNA), banana. Is mein rDNA ko mezbaan (host), jaise bacteria, mein dalna bhi shamil hai taa ke naye genetic milap ya khaas proteins banein.

blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif zaraye ka DNA jor kar bana aik hybrid DNA molecule.

items: rDNA: mukhtalif zaraye ka DNA mila hua; naye milap ya proteins ke liye host mein dala jata.
